summary: School-zone through road with no parked cars; homes 7-13 m behind the kerb.
reasons: Through road, no cars parked on this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses front straight onto this kerb at 7-13 m; nothing screens it.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed lane with kerb-to-fence verge on the west side; no pull-off beside it.
drivers.traffic: Through road at a school entrance with a marked parking bay on the other side.
drivers.convention: No cars parked on this west kerb; no stopping 7-9am and 2-4pm on school days.

flags: Mapped gate 22 m away with a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open; street trees shade the east side, houses block the west.
